confirm.title: Confirm file closure
confirm.message: Are you sure you want to close the current file? Any unsaved changes will be lost

confirmMultiple.title: Confirm file closure
confirmMultiple.message: Are you sure you want to close file? Any unsaved changes will be lost

classicMode.title: Classic Zoom Mode
classicMode.text: 100% zoom means the entire image fits inside the workspace. The zoom level depends only on the visible area of the editor.

physicalMode.title: Physical Zoom Mode
physicalMode.text: 100% zoom represents the real physical size of the image on your screen. For example, 10 cm in the image corresponds to 10 cm on your monitor. Calibration may be required for accurate scaling.

physicalContentSize.tip: Set the real-world image width at 100% zoom in centimeters

calibrateButton.tip: Calibrate your screen to match on-screen measurements with real-world dimensions

needCalibration.title: Calibration required
needCalibration.message: To use physical zoom accurately, please calibrate your screen first

button.tip: Adjust the scroll speed in the viewport. Higher values allow for faster panning.
